# NKY Cabinet Refacing Pros

## About
NKY Cabinet Refacing Pros refaces kitchen cabinets, bathroom vanities, and built-in cabinetry for homes in Northern Kentucky (Boone, Kenton, and Campbell counties). Free estimates by phone: (859) 900-8065.

## Services
- Kitchen cabinet refacing: new doors and drawer fronts on existing cabinet boxes, most kitchens done in 3-5 days
- Cabinet door replacement in shaker, raised-panel, flat-panel, and other styles
- Cabinet hardware and accessories: hinges, handles, drawer slides, pull-out shelves, soft-close upgrades

## Service Areas
Florence, Covington, Fort Thomas, Newport, Fort Mitchell, Erlanger, Edgewood, and Independence, Kentucky.
